title: gonostemon rubiginosus
intro: Gonostemon rubiginosus, commonly known as the Red Sage, is a plant species in the Asphodelaceae family, native to southern Africa. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Red Sage include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents in Gonostemon rubiginosus contribute to its potential health benefits, which may include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant protection.
